category.leaf: 推拉式全屏指纹智能门锁

description: 推拉式握位指纹开门、全屏感应键盘、虚位密码防偷窥、APP远程管家智能门锁套图

styleLock.direction: premium smart-home tech ecommerce, dark hero scenes alternating with clean infographic panels
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep black-teal gradient scenes with diagonal glow streaks and clean white or light-grey infographic panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: low-key dramatic light with diagonal glow streaks and cyan rim glow on dark scenes; bright even high-key with soft contact shadow on infographic panels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glass-black panel surface, walnut wood-grain door, hexagonal wireframe tech floor, matte light-grey backdrop
styleLock.typography: geometric techno square sans-serif for headlines, clean sans-serif labels, short labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line glowing cyan icons, minimal complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: slim upright smart lock centered at a named angle per shot, stable scale, soft contact shadow, never floating
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium smart-home tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep space black-teal #0B1117, clean white #FFFFFF, soft light grey #F4F6F8, and one tech cyan accent #2FC6E8; cool tone throughout; dark scenes use low-key dramatic light with diagonal glow streaks and cyan rim glow, infographic panels use bright even high-key light with soft contact shadow; geometric techno square sans-serif headlines with short clean labels; thin-line glowing cyan icons; alternating deep dark hero scenes and clean light infographic sections; slim upright smart lock presented centered at a named angle with soft contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 用暗夜科技感主视觉建立高端第一印象，一秒锁定点击
shots.camera: low-angle 3/4 view looking slightly upward, full product visible
shots.lighting: low-key dramatic, diagonal teal glow streaks, cyan rim glow on panel edge, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep black-teal gradient with diagonal light streaks #0B1117
shots.textZone: 左侧竖排白色标题「{selling_point_1}」与副行「{callout_1}」，配小青色圆点装饰
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce dark hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: first-glance premium tech impression. Low-angle 3/4 view looking slightly upward, full product visible, floating slightly above ground with a soft contact shadow, the lock anchored to the right and filling 50-60% of the frame as the anchor of one balanced composition. Low-key dramatic lighting, diagonal teal glow streaks across the frame, cyan #2FC6E8 rim glow on the panel edge. Deep black-teal gradient background #0B1117. The left side of the frame carries a vertical white headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and sub-line 「{callout_1}」 in techno sans-serif with small cyan dot accents, completing the layout. 2K commercial quality. Negative: no brand names, no fake logos, no garbled text, no watermark, no floating product without contact shadow, no extra props, no color palette drift.

shots.textZone: 四个青色线条图标下方各一行白色短标签：「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: show four ways to unlock in one glance. Straight-on symmetrical layout: product partially visible at the top, below it a 2x2 grid of thin-line glowing cyan icons standing on a hexagonal wireframe tech floor, labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in white. Low-key lighting with cyan glow, deep black background #0B1117 with a faint purple-blue gradient at the horizon. The product and icon grid together fill 40-50% of the frame in one centered balanced layout. 2K. Negative: no fake brand logos, no garbled text, no readable app UI, no watermark, no more than four icons, no color drift.

shots.intent: 全屏玻璃键盘微距证明一体工艺与面板质感

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, one subtle diagonal reflection on glass, soft contact shadow

Straight-on eye-level, panel upright filling the frame vertically, glass-black surface with one subtle diagonal reflection, clock area and simplified keypad glyphs as clean generic UI, small card-sense mark at the center key, cyan wave light bar at the bottom #2FC6E8. shots.textZone: 左上角一行白色短标签「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene of {product} on a dark walnut door shown half-open. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: show natural one-grip push-pull opening. Eye-level documentary side view: door edge reveals the mortise lock body with extended bolts, a hand naturally grips the push-pull handle where the fingerprint sensor sits. Cool-neutral soft window light from the left at 5000K, natural shadows, walnut wood-grain door as warm prop material, softly blurred living room behind. The door and lock fill 50-60% of the frame as one full living composition. Text zone: short label 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF at top-left, completing the layout. 2K. Straight-on structured two-column spec table on deep black #0B1117 filling the frame as one complete balanced layout: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 top-left in white #FFFFFF, six short spec labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 with values in clean grey #9AA3AB, thin dividers #4A5560, cyan label accents #2FC6E8. provenance.notes: 10 张 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。已剥离：源品牌与 APP 界面型号字样、尾部门店会员二维码促销图；APP 界面一律改为无文字图形元素。分类纠正：源文件夹名为家装家具家用品，但主体为电子智能门锁，按 taxonomy 判定为手机数码/智能家居。与库内两款门锁模版（全自动一握即开款、执手式虚位密码款）以推拉式把手 + 全屏感应键盘定位区分。
